add.title: Add a fault
empty.title: No faults
empty.description: A fault makes traffic through the proxy slow or fail on purpose, to test how an app copes. Faults are kept in memory until cleared or the engine stops.
error.range: {field} must be a whole number from {min} to {max}.
error.break: Break connection must be drop or reset, or empty.
error.nothing: A fault needs a latency, a status, or drop or reset.
error.alone: Drop and reset cannot be combined with latency or status.
page.description: Faults slow down or fail traffic through the forward proxy, to test how an app copes. They live in the engine until cleared.
